name: supplier-feed
title: Supplier product uses a different field name (KeyError)
description: A catalogue import adds SKU-1006 with the supplier's field name 'unit_price'. Pricing code (unchanged for days) reads product['price'] and crashes for orders containing it. The culprit commit did NOT touch the crashing line, so git blame points at old code: the analyzer must read the diffs to find the real cause.

commits.author: Karan Mehta <karan@shop.example>
commits.message:
Import DockCo supplier catalogue: add SKU-1006 and first order

Products from the supplier feed keep the feed's field names (unit_price, supplier).

commits.author: Ananya Iyer <ananya@shop.example>
